nibiru.noteFar: A WORLD WIT NO SUN, FALLIN' IN OUT OF DA DARK ON A COURSE NOBODY PLOTTED AN' NOBODY CAN BEND. DA EPHEMERIDES PUT IT OVER EARTH ON DA TWENTY-FIRST OF DECEMBER, 2012!
nibiru.noteNear: INSIDE DA SYSTEM NOW, AN' NO LONGER SLOWIN'. IT HOLDS EARTH'S OWN ANGLE EXACTLY, WHICH IZ ANOTHER WAY OF SAYIN' IT IZ NOT GOING TA MISS!
nibiru.saturnNote: NIBIRU WENT INTO DA GIANT INSTEAD, AN' DA GIANT CAUGHT. SATURN BURNS NOW: NOT ENOUGH TA BE A STAR, FAR TOO MUCH TA STILL BE A PLANET. DA RINGS WENT FIRST!
nibiru.towerNote: WHERE EARTH STOOD DERE IZ A BLACK LANCE TWELVE KILOMETRES TALL, GOLD AT EVERY EDGE, TURNIN' IN DA ORBIT ITS WORLD LEFT BEHIND. NOTHIN' ON IT ANSWERS, AN' ONE DOOR IZ OPEN!
nibiru.entered: NIBIRU HAB CROSSED INTO DA SOLAR SYSTEM!
nibiru.hitSaturn: NIBIRU HAB STRUCK SATURN. DA GIANT IZ BURNIN'!
nibiru.hitEarth: NIBIRU HAB STRUCK DA EARTH. BOTH IZ GONE!

hubbleQuest.title: REFIT OF DA HUBBLE SPACE TELESCOPE
hubbleQuest.body: DA OLD OBSERVATORY IZ STILL UP DERE, HOLDIN' ITS ONE ASTRONOMICAL UNIT ORBIT AN' POINTIN' AT NOTHIN'. HALF ITS ASSEMBLIES IZ DEAD, DA REST IZ RUNNIN' ON DEY MARGINS, AN' DA DOWNLINK HAB BEEN QUIET FOR YEARS. BRING DA SHIP ALONGSIDE, OPEN DA SERVICIN' BAY AN' PUT DA TELESCOPE BACK TA WORK ONE ASSEMBLY AT A TIME!
hubbleQuest.objectives: RESTORE EVERY ASSEMBLY OF DA HUBBLE SPACE TELESCOPE FROM DA SHIP'S SERVICIN' BAY!
terms: DA BAY ONLY OPENS WHILE DA SHIP HOLDS STATION IN DA TELESCOPE'S ORBIT, IN DA SOL SYSTEM!
EVERY REPAIR IZ PAID FOR IN CRAFTIN' MATERIALS, AN' A WORSE FAULT COSTS MORE!
NOTHIN' HERE IZ TIMED: A HALF-SERVICED TELESCOPE STAYS HALF-SERVICED!
hubbleQuest.reward: DEEP FIELD IMAGIN': DOUBLE RANGE ON DA BIOSIGNATURE SWEEP
